statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54448 (GHSA-q3fv-x8vg-qqm4, GO-2026-5983): Trivy's Helm chart parser read archived charts with an unbounded io.ReadAll, so a tar bomb inside a scanned chart could exhaust memory. It affects github.com/aquasecurity/trivy before 0.71.0, in pkg/iac/scanners/helm (Scanner.ScanFS), its parser (New, Parser.ParseFS, Parser.RenderedChartFiles, Parser.unpackArchive) and pkg/iac/detection (IsArchive). Sources: https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/security/advisories/GHSA-q3fv-x8vg-qqm4, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5983, the fix commit https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/commit/441251e51ae46cbcf7f436547e0a5766b25328b4 (https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pull/10718, which replaces the custom archive parsing with the Helm SDK loaders) and https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/tag/v0.71.0. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 27 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux (GOOS=linux) built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We matched the program in every package, by the checksum the package records for it, to a copy we read in full. The -dev program is built from the same Go release and module versions as the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same version, but without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath. Its Go build information, the same on both architectures, gives the Go toolchain go1.26.2 in 1.20.4-r1, go1.26.3 in 1.20.4-r2 to 1.21.0-r0, go1.26.4 in 1.21.0-r1 to 1.21.0-r2, go1.26.5 in 1.21.0-r3 to 1.23.1-r1, go1.26.6 in 1.23.1-r3, go1.26.7 in 1.23.1-r4 to 1.23.1-r5, go1.26.8 in 1.23.1-r6, go1.27.1 in 1.23.1-r8 to 1.23.1-r10, go1.27.2 in 1.26.0-r1, go1.27.3 in 1.26.0-r2 to 1.29.0-r1, go1.27.4 in 1.30.0-r0, and github.com/aquasecurity/trivy, with no replacement, v0.66.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r10, v0.75.0 in 1.26.0-r1 to 1.30.0-r0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows Trivy's Helm scanner and parser (pkg/iac/scanners/helm.(*Scanner).ScanFS and pkg/iac/scanners/helm/parser.(*Parser).ParseFS) linked. The custom archive reader that the fix removes, parser.(*Parser).unpackArchive, is linked in every build before 1.26.0-r1 and in none from 1.26.0-r1 on. 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r10 carry github.com/aquasecurity/trivy v0.66.0, before the fixed v0.71.0, while every build from 1.26.0-r1 on carries v0.75.0 (which contains the fix commit), so 1.26.0-r1 is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-54448 (GHSA-q3fv-x8vg-qqm4, GO-2026-5983): Trivy's Helm chart parser read archived charts with an unbounded io.ReadAll, so a tar bomb inside a scanned chart could exhaust memory. It affects github.com/aquasecurity/trivy before 0.71.0, in pkg/iac/scanners/helm (Scanner.ScanFS), its parser (New, Parser.ParseFS, Parser.RenderedChartFiles, Parser.unpackArchive) and pkg/iac/detection (IsArchive). Sources: https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/security/advisories/GHSA-q3fv-x8vg-qqm4, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5983, the fix commit https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/commit/441251e51ae46cbcf7f436547e0a5766b25328b4 (https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pull/10718, which replaces the custom archive parsing with the Helm SDK loaders) and https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/tag/v0.71.0. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository as of 27 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-1 to the current 1.30.0-0, on amd64 and arm64 (50 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux (GOOS=linux) built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We matched the program in every package, by the checksum the package records for it, to a copy we read in full.
